messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] 3xx spike + token error rate increase from edge POPs in us-west2 detected. Source: CDN ingress telemetry. Severity: P2.

oncall_sre_1: acknowledged. I'm on it — paging neteng and support.

wei_sre: looking. seeing increased latency and 15-30% packet loss to 18.213.45.1 (us-west2-pop-a). MTR attached in a sec.

anita_neteng: I'm switching to the POP peering console now. Any customer-facing impact reported?

mike_support: Support queue: 8 tickets in the last 10m, multiple customers reporting timeouts for embeddings and streaming. Marking as "potential CDN/edge".

oncall_sre_1: quick mitigation plan: 1) fail traffic away from affected POP via geo-steer override, 2) remove aggressive keepalive proxies, 3) coordinate with CDN provider for mitigation. Starting step 1 now.

incident-bot: [ACTION] oncall_sre_1 changed route policy: geo-steer override -> prefer us-west1/us-west3 for us-west2 prefixes.

wei_sre: traceroute to 18.213.45.1 shows loss at the POP hop 6/7 (looks like last-mile).

```
traceroute to 18.213.45.1 (18.213.45.1), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.6.2.1 (10.6.2.1)  0.323 ms  0.289 ms  0.273 ms
 2  172.16.5.1 (172.16.5.1)  1.24 ms  1.12 ms  1.10 ms
 3  203.0.113.4 (203.0.113.4)  8.34 ms  8.10 ms  8.05 ms
 4  198.51.100.9 (198.51.100.9)  12.5 ms 12.7 ms 12.4 ms
 5  198.51.100.17 (198.51.100.17)  18.3 ms 19.1 ms 18.7 ms
 6  18.213.45.1 (18.213.45.1)  packet loss 25%  packet loss 30%  packet loss 28%
 7  * * *
```

oncall_sre_1: confirmed — loss concentrated at POP edge. Contacting provider. @apexedge_status_bot any updates?

apexedge_status_bot: We are currently investigating elevated packet loss affecting some POPs in US-WEST-2. Engineers have identified increased errors at the upstream aggregator and are rolling a hotfix. Next update in 10m.

anita_neteng: On our side I see BGP flaps from the ISP connecting that POP (ASN 65056) around the same time. Looks like a cross-connect intermittently rejecting packets. Opening ticket with provider NOC now.

mike_support: Posted interim status to customer-facing status page: "Degraded performance in US-West regions for some users; working with CDN partner." Adding list of affected services.

wei_sre: As mitigation I have: - temporarily shifted traffic away (geo-steer) - disabled edge session affinity for embeddings route to allow reroute - bumped keepalive timeout back to defaults. Observed tail latency dropping ~45% after shift.

oncall_sre_1: Good. @elaine_pm can you notify the top 5 affected customers via their AMs? We should include ETA and that we've mitigated traffic.

elaine_pm: will do, sending a short note now.

oncall_sre_1: Provider NOC confirms: "We saw a port flapping at the aggregation switch in SJC POP-3 causing microbursts and buffer drops. Replacement patching started; ETA 30 minutes."

wei_sre: Running continuous pings and MTR to confirm stability. After reroute, ping loss to upstream aggregator down to 0-1%.

incident-bot: [NOTE] Routing shift reduced customer errors by ~60% in last 7m. Monitoring for regression.

mike_support: Support queue update: new tickets slowed. We'll keep CS escalations brief — note mitigation applied.

anita_neteng: Still seeing a minority of flows bouncing back to the affected POP due to DNS TTLs. Recommend setting low TTL for the region's DNS A records (30s) to speed propagation. I can push change if approved.

oncall_sre_1: Approved. Make the TTL change and request cache purge for geo-steer rules.

anita_neteng: Done. TTL 30s pushed. Cleared CDN dns cache for us-west2 prefixes.

apexedge_status_bot: Hotfix deployment completed on upstream aggregator. Packet loss metrics improving. Final verification in progress.

wei_sre: Observed stabilization across the board. Packet loss to 18.213.45.1 under 1% and RTT normal.

incident-bot: [RESOLUTION] Provider reports issue resolved. Monitoring continues for 2h.

oncall_sre_1: handing off to oncall_sre_2 for watch window. Summary: transient port flap at provider aggregation switch caused 15-30% loss at SJC POP; we geo-steered traffic, set low DNS TTL to accelerate failover, and coordinated provider hotfix. Customer impact: degraded streaming/embedding for some customers in US-West for ~22 minutes, mitigations reduced errors by ~60% within 8 minutes.

oncall_sre_2: taking watch. I'll follow up with postmortem template and assign owners.

elaine_pm: scheduling incident review with PMs + Support + NetEng for later today. Also drafting customer post-incident note.

mike_support: thanks all — closing high-priority tickets as mitigated, will reopen if customers report re-occurrence. :thumbsup:

oncall_sre_2: leaving a TODO: 1) postmortem (owner: wei_sre), 2) add test to synthetic checks to detect last-hop buffer drops, 3) review geo-steer automation to make reroute faster.

wei_sre: will take postmortem. I'll include packet captures, traceroutes, DNS TTL timeline, and exact mitigation timestamps.

incident-bot: Thread locked for edits. Final state: monitoring, watch by oncall_sre_2.
